text_block_list.text:
—A new year.
Unprecedented waves and movements were beginning to stir around T.M. Opera O.
(WOOOAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it, she's done it, Meisho Doto!
Crossing the line in 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Starting out away from the spotlight, she built up her record
and is finally making waves in graded races!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I somehow... pulled through...
Even I am, little by little...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, look at the TV, Trainer-kun!
Doto is...! That Doto is...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "She's bound to come greet me after this, surely saying she was able to grow all thanks to me!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes! Now then, Doto, don't hold back—
sing your heart out with gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... I want to thank you too, but
there's something far more serious...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a press conference is about to start.
For the three of them—Special Week-san, Grass Wonder-san, and El Condor Pasa-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What? A press conference by the Three Musketeers of the previous generation...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gathered here today!
I have an important announcement to make!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The three of us—Special Week,
Grass Wonder, and El Condor Pasa……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Starting next year, I won't be running
in the Twinkle Series anymore!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhh!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean you'll be retiring
at the end of this year?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I've achieved a certain degree of results,
so I thought I'd try my best
in the Dream Trophy League next.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ciao, everyone! Is this farewell!?
Is this goodbye forever in this lifetime!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahn!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, you're not actually quitting, are you?
Don't cause misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: The three who spearheaded the Twinkle Series moving on to the next league all at once, huh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Next year... will things be okay?
It feels like all the excitement will suddenly die down, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
Ngh, guuuuh...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable!
To think those three are departing for the next stage!
And what's most unforgivable is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
All three of them are standing out far more
than me! Even though we're in the same Senior class!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Good grief... I'll have to reclaim the spotlight that was stolen from me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, please prepare this side as well.
For the press conference!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Substance? Hahaha,
as if something like that could possibly exist.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm going to think about that now.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what do you mean 'no substance'...
Opera O-san...!

Driven by her competitive spirit, T.M. Opera O
decided to hold her own press conference at a later date.
And on the day of the press conference—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fans who love Umamusume! Members of the media!
Have you heard? The news that those three are setting off!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Only one year remains.
Which means we must achieve the changing of the guard before then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
So who will inherit the throne from them?!
Just who will it be?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to proclaim it! It is I! None other than I,
TM Opera O, could it possibly be!
For you see...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because I am the "Overlord"!
Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: I-I see...

"I don't really get the logic behind it,
but everyone is just swept up in T.M. Opera O's momentum."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I make thee this promise. Throughout this year, I shall deliver results
befitting a king who stands at the summit of a new era.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho, the Japan Cup, and then the Arima Kinen!
I'll deliver results across every single GⅠ and build my dynasty!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The era of chaos and rival warlords is over.
From now on, a single, most trusted king
shall rule.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is the dawn of the T.M. Opera O dynasty!
This year is not one of sunset, but the year a new sun rises!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Witness the birth of a new King,
and follow in my wake!!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!

Everyone is left in awe by her bold declaration.
Now in the Senior Class, even her speeches seem to carry genuine dignity.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is incredible...
She cheered Ayabe-san up before too, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: To think she'd become even more incredible and blow everyone away this time... U-Uuuu...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten stronger too... I want Opera O-san to recognize me as a rival.
But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the courage to say it...
I can't... I just can't say it...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And if I succeed in establishing my dynasty—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is secure!
As a thousand-year kingdom, its glory shall endure forever!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no longer any need
to rely on three departing heroes, is there?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let's cast them out with a bold 'Bye-bye, Adieu!'
shall we? Ah-hahaha!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, picking a fight, are we~? When trouble's selling, it's a must-buy for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, we can't afford to lose this
until the very, very end, yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you're right~.
Let's be sure to repay the favor in full.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then El will go train
so she can intercept them! Ciao!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El... didn't seem to notice at all,
did she? But...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see, Opera O-san.
So the real reason you called this press conference is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Out of consideration for the dejected fans...
Or perhaps it was completely subconscious.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'm so glad...
that you are in the generation below me...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There, now my declaration is made, Trainer-kun!
I've reclaimed my spot as the protagonist.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Rubicon has been crossed! All that remains is to run through
this year of decisive battles toward the "Overlord of the End of the Century"!
Bwa-ha-ha-ha!
And so, with the sudden announcement from three popular Umamusume, the flagging excitement for the Twinkle Series—

With T.M. Opera O's resounding declaration,
energy surged right back into the air.
A year of heated generational rivalry was about to begin!
